daily.today_energy: Your vibe is communicative and curious today—lean into those random conversations that feel meaningful. Mercury's got your back, so trust the flow of ideas bouncing around your brain rn.
daily.love: Whether single or coupled, authenticity is your superpower today. Say the thing you've been holding back. Someone's waiting to hear the real you, and vulnerability hits different when it's genuine.
